appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.dockHint: SeshBuddy keeps running after this is turned off; it just won't stay in the Dock.

terminal.externalAppHint: The terminal used by "Restore / New session in terminal" and the system context menu; only installed apps are listed.
terminal.rendererWebglHint: High performance, depends on GPU drivers
terminal.rendererDomHint: Most compatible, slower with heavy output
terminal.rendererFallbackHint: Terminal renderer. Changes take effect in newly opened terminal sessions.
terminal.agentStatusOscHint: Detects status through terminal escape sequences, no extra process needed
terminal.agentStatusHookRelayHint: Receives full hook data through seshbuddy-proxy

integration.contextMenuHint: Once registered, launch {name} directly from the Finder / File Explorer context menu.
integration.contextMenuUnsupported: The current CLI does not support system context menu integration yet.

cache.tempConfigDesc: Temporary merged configs generated by CLI session restore commands; the system also cleans them up periodically
cache.cleanSuccess: Cleanup complete. Temporary config files deleted: {count}

blockedFolders.desc: Blocked folders are hidden from the conversation tree and project panel, and excluded from usage stats by default.
blockedFolders.emptyHint: Right-click a folder in the conversation tree or project panel and choose "Block this folder", or add one directly

index.autoSyncDesc: Periodically scans for new sessions in the background and syncs the full-text index, so searching never asks you to update it
index.rebuildAllTitle: Recomputes the full-text index of every active CLI in turn; useful for diagnosing global search issues
index.cliPickerDesc: Switch between CLIs to inspect their index metrics and run per-CLI maintenance
index.rebuildOneTitle: Clears the old index and fully recomputes every session of this CLI (favorites, bookmarks and renames are unaffected)
index.clearTitle: Clears the local index cache of this CLI
index.currentCliRebuilding: This CLI is being rebuilt as part of the global task
index.clearConfirm: This clears the list index and search index of the selected CLI (favorites, bookmarks and custom names are unaffected). Continue?

archive.title: Snapshot retention
archive.hintForever: Session snapshots stay in the local archive forever and never expire on their own.
archive.hintImmediate: As soon as the matching CLI removes the original session file, its local archive snapshot is cleaned up too.
archive.hintYears: After the matching CLI removes the session file, its local archive snapshot stays viewable for about {years} yr ({days} d).
archive.hintDays: After the matching CLI removes the session file, its local archive snapshot stays viewable for {days} d.
archive.inputAria: Enter the retention period in days
archive.badgeTitle: Click to type a custom number of days

archivedSessions.scanTitle: Scans the archives directory on disk and rebuilds the database index
archivedSessions.restoreTitle: Unpacks the archive snapshot back onto disk so the CLI can resume the conversation
archivedSessions.deleteSnapshotTitle: Delete the archive snapshot (the original file stays on disk)
archivedSessions.hint: Sessions older than 28 days are snapshotted into the archive automatically; archives marked "Keep forever" ignore the retention period and are never cleaned up. Click a session to open it in the main window.
archivedSessions.restoreSuccess: The archived session was unpacked back onto disk; the CLI can resume it now.
archivedSessions.deleteHintSourceExists: This deletes the archive snapshot of this session (the original session file is unaffected).
archivedSessions.deleteHintSourceMissing: The original session file is gone; deleting the archive removes this session from the list for good, with no way back.
